name: Delivery timeline
description: Scheduled work on one timeline, with what is still ahead.
long_description:
Puts every dated task in the initiative on a shared timeline, grouped into lanes, with the open count beside it and the full list below.

Tasks with no start or due date do not appear on the timeline — they are still counted, and still listed.
release_notes: Adds what is past its date and what has been finished lately.

binding.sql: SELECT title, start_date, due_date FROM tasks WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL AND due_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY start_date
SELECT count(*) AS tasks FROM tasks WHERE due_date IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL
SELECT count(*) AS overdue FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL AND due_date < now()
SELECT count(*) AS finished FROM tasks WHERE completed_at >= now() - CAST('30 days' AS interval)
SELECT count(completed_at) AS finished, count(*) AS total FROM tasks
SELECT title, start_date, due_date, priority FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL ORDER BY due_date
